text: We took NVIDIA's Parakeet and made it better. Introducing Fluid Speech Mini: the best Open Source Model purpose-built for Dictation. With SOTA performance under 300 MB. Run it on your iPhone, Mac, or PC. No cloud, no internet.
take: Open-source dictation (speech-to-text) model built on NVIDIA Parakeet, under 300 MB, runs offline on iPhone/Mac/PC; well received.

text: Now comes Drama 3: our most emotive & controllable TTS model. You can direct a voice in plain English, add different emotions to a single sentence, and control how even a single word should sound. It's also open-weight.
take: Fish Audio's Drama 3 is an open-weight text-to-speech model you can direct in plain English, down to single words.

text: ElevenLabs CEO opening X this morning to find his entire product released with open weights
take: Viral reaction: people see Fish Audio's open-weight Drama 3 as an ElevenLabs-level voice model you can run yourself.

text: Text-to-speech models receive little attention, yet they are currently experiencing similar breakthroughs: Fish Audio's Drama 3 lets you direct an AI voice much like you'd direct a voice actor.
take: Praise for Drama 3's acting-style control of emotion within a sentence.

text: Grok Voice 3.0 is now the world's leading conversational voice model
take: xAI claims Grok Voice 3.0 is the top conversational voice model; closed, API-only.

text: Today we release LFM2.5-24B-A2B, the largest LFM2.5 family member. It is an efficient local model for laptops and PCs to work through multi-step tasks inside popular agent harnesses. 24B total parameters, 2B active per token. Context expanded to 131K tokens.
take: Liquid AI's biggest LFM2.5: a 24B mixture-of-experts (2B active) local agent model for laptops, 131K context; strong reception.

text: Best models for your hardware October. 4GB to 8GB VRAM: Smoll but mighty huggingface.co/LiquidAI/LFM2.5-2.6B. 8GB to 16GB VRAM: Underdog Saluki huggingface.co/ConwayResearch/Underdog-Saluki-27B-1.0, closest you'll get to frontier on this memory tier. It's a custom post train of Qwen.
take: Popular hardware-tier roundup: LFM2.5-2.6B for 4-8GB, Underdog Saluki 27B (Qwen post-train) for 8-16GB.

text: Paper Instruments launches Ultramarine 1 Flash, an open-source model from a five-person American lab. It is post-trained with reinforcement learning to handle the work of bankers, consultants and lawyers. Weights releasing soon; API available now.
take: Five-person lab claims frontier-class knowledge-work model for ~$300k; API now, weights promised soon. Hype mixed with skepticism.

text: With @GovTechSG, we're building on-device fraud detection using our open model Gemma. By fine-tuning it on local scam tactics, it identifies threats in real time.
take: Example of Gemma fine-tuned for on-device scam detection in Singapore.
